questions.stem: Which technique is commonly used in computer graphics for rendering detailed images of the Andromeda Galaxy?
questions.solution: Ray tracing simulates light interactions, making it suitable for complex scenes like galaxies. Rasterization is faster but less detailed.
questions.explanation: Rasterization is used for real-time graphics, shadow mapping creates shadows, and normal mapping adds surface detail without extra polygons.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Choosing B (Rasterization) as it's faster, but ray tracing is more accurate for detailed scenes.

questions.stem: Which computer graphics method simulates the appearance of realistic water in a scene?
questions.solution: Particle systems create fluid motion, essential for simulating water. Other techniques enhance texture or lighting.
questions.explanation: Fog volumes add atmospheric effects, normal mapping and bump mapping improve surface detail without changing geometry.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Choosing C (Normal mapping) or D (Bump mapping) as they enhance texture, but not for fluid motion simulation.

questions.stem: What technique is used in real-time computer graphics to efficiently render large outdoor terrains?
questions.solution: LOD adjusts model complexity based on distance, optimizing real-time rendering. Ray marching and SSAO are for other effects.
questions.explanation: Ray marching is for volumetric rendering, screen space reflections add realism to reflective surfaces, and SSAO enhances ambient lighting.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Choosing B (Ray marching) as it's related to rendering, but LOD is more suitable for real-time terrains.

questions.stem: Which method reduces jagged edges, or aliasing, in rendered computer graphics images?
questions.solution: TAA averages frames to smooth edges, improving image quality. Mipmapping affects texture detail.
questions.explanation: Mipmapping enhances texture resolution, bloom creates an over-exposed effect, and depth of field adjusts focus.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Choosing B (Mipmapping) as it impacts textures, but TAA is for aliasing reduction.

questions.stem: What approach in computer graphics produces realistic lighting and materials?
questions.solution: PBR models light interactions based on physics, resulting in lifelike appearances. Older techniques are less accurate.
questions.explanation: Gouraud and Phong shading are outdated methods, vertex lighting affects only mesh vertices.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Choosing B (Phong shading) as an older technique, but PBR is more realistic.

questions.stem: What computer graphics method simulates fire behavior and appearance?
questions.solution: Fluid dynamics simulates complex behaviors like fire by modeling particle movement. Other techniques enhance visuals.
questions.explanation: Procedural texture generation creates textures, shadow mapping adds shadows, and normal mapping enhances surface detail.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Choosing B (Procedural texture generation) as it generates textures, but not for simulating fire behavior.

questions.stem: Which technique is used in real-time applications like games to animate characters?
questions.solution: Skinning with skeletal animation allows for realistic character movements by attaching a mesh to bones. Other techniques are suited for other tasks.
questions.explanation: Lattice deformation changes shape, vertex displacement mapping adds detail, and particle systems simulate fluids or particles.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Choosing B (Lattice deformation) as it can change shape, but skinning with skeletal animation is better for character animations.
